policy: Only explicit APPROVED entries may enter production training; status is never inferred by code.

mlaad_tiny_matched.evidence: existing pinned MLAAD snapshot and manifest
mlaad_tiny_matched.approval_basis: pinned source manifest records URL, revision, CC BY-NC 4.0, and competition-use review

echoes_fma_paired.license: generated CC BY-SA 4.0; selected FMA originals have explicit CC licenses
echoes_fma_paired.approval_basis: generated tracks CC BY-SA 4.0 and selected FMA originals retain explicit row-level CC URLs

dfadd_vctk_paired.license: MIT dataset release; VCTK CC BY 4.0
dfadd_vctk_paired.approval_basis: official DFADD release is MIT; upstream VCTK originals are CC BY 4.0; exact pair filenames and archive hash recorded

wavefake_ajay_mirror.reason: official WaveFake is CC BY-SA 4.0, but the local mirror snapshot/version mapping is not recorded

sonics_official.role: fake-only music review; prohibited from unpaired production scaling
sonics_official.reason: row-level source and generator-output evidence is incomplete

aime.reason: generated tracks and MTG-Jamendo originals have different/per-track terms

musebench.reason: collection license does not replace heterogeneous Jamendo per-track licenses

fakemusiccaps.reason: CC BY-NC 4.0 repository; MusicCaps originals are not redistributed and source rights require row-level review

scdf.reason: candidate completely unseen voice final; must be acquired and globally history-audited before sealing

speechfake.reason: CC BY 4.0 with documented upstream exceptions; per-subset review required

artifactbench_v1_1.reason: CC BY-NC 4.0 benchmark with 22 generators and six real-source labels, but real audio includes user-retrieved YouTube IDs and FMA/SONICS overlap; row-level rights and global-history disjointness must be resolved
artifactbench_v1_1.candidate_role: music unseen/source-disjoint validation only, never automatic training approval
